quote: Recently, CSCEC-built first phase of Nicaragua's affordable housing project, undertaken by CSCEC, has been successfully completed and handed over. The first phase of the project involved the construction of 920 single-story, two-bedroom houses in the city of Managua, along with supporting infrastructure such as roads and utility networks within the community.
note: Opened CSCEC English 25 Aug 2025 Nuevas Victorias Phase 1 handover release.
